title: Emphatic Fronting with Figurative Phrases
goal: Front figurative and idiomatic phrases with subject-verb inversion for emphasis in narrative and speech.

items: I can front figurative phrases such as *sin rodeos*, *a ciegas* and *ni una palabra* with subject-verb inversion.
I can drop *no* before the verb after a fronted negative phrase.
I can use figurative narrative vocabulary (*el hilo*, *romper el hielo*, *desenredar*) accurately.
